The '''Eridauan consulate''' was an embassy on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Malastare/Legends|Malastare]] that was operated by representatives from the world [[Eriadu/Legends|Eriadu]] during the latter [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. In [[54 BBY/Legends|54 BBY]], a gala was held at the consulate to congratulate the winners of the [[Vinta Harvest Classic/Legends|Vinta Harvest Classic]] [[Podracing/Legends|podracing]] challenge, and the event was attended by a number of Republic [[Senator/Legends|senators]] and other influential beings.
